summary: Candidate is a distinct, well-defined capability for tick generation and formatting. It combines scale.ticks() and scale.tickFormat() into a cohesive workflow step that is narrower and more specific than the peer 'Axis Generator Configuration' skill (which wraps axis.ticks() and axis.tickFormat() as part of broader axis setup). No redundancy detected with peers. Support evidence confirms D3 scale API backing. No conflicts present.
